cells.gaps: No source found since 2024 says a child has received the new number. NIDA's June 2024 remark that it now issues identity from birth disagrees with the 2026 sources, which put issue from birth still to come.
cells.note: The 2023 law provides for a Single Digital Identity Number from birth, piloted from October 2025 with issue planned from October 2026: stage 2. The newest facts stand over the 2024 remark.
